formula: Subject + verb + that there is / was no telling + wh-clause

formulas.formula: Subject + verb + that there is / was no telling + wh-clause

example: There is no telling how long the repairs will take.
exampleZh: 維修工程需要多長時間，實在無法預料。

examples.en: There is no telling how long the repairs will take.
examples.zh: 維修工程需要多長時間，實在無法預料。
examples.highlight: There is no telling how long the repairs will take.

rules.zh: 核心表達是 There is no telling 以下部分才是固定核心：【There is no telling】 後面的 how、when、where 等內容，說明「哪一項資料無法得知」。會議會持續多久，實在無法預料。
rules.en: There is no telling There is no telling how long the meeting will last.

rules.zh: 可以使用不同的 wh-words 常見形式包括：【what；who；where；when；why；which；how；how long】 無法預料會發生甚麼事。 無法得知火車何時到達。 無法預料計劃能否成功。
rules.en: what who where when why which how how long how much how many how quickly whether There is no telling what will happen. There is no telling when the train will arrive. There is no telling whether the plan will succeed.

rules.zh: 使用陳述句語序後面接的是嵌入式問句，不是直接問句。正確：【There is no telling when the train will arrive.】 錯誤：【There is no telling when will the train arrive.】 正確：【There is no telling why the machine stopped.】 錯誤：【There is no telling why did the machine stop.】
rules.en: Wh-clause There is no telling There is no telling when the train will arrive. There is no telling when will the train arrive. There is no telling why the machine stopped. There is no telling why did the machine stop.

rules.zh: 整句通常不是問題這是一個陳述句，所以句末使用句號，而不是問號。
rules.en: There is no telling when the train will arrive.

rules.zh: 過去情況使用 There was no telling 無法得知他現在身在何處。 當時無法得知他去了哪裏。 時態必須配合句子的時間背景。
rules.en: Present: There is no telling where he is now. Past: There was no telling where he had gone.

rules.zh: 前置短語不是固定表達的一部分以下句子中的 At present、Without more evidence 和 Until Friday 都只是提供背景：【At present, there is no telling when the work will finish.】 刪去前置短語後，核心句子仍然完整：【There is no telling when the work will finish.】
rules.en: At present, there is no telling when the work will finish. Without more evidence, there is no telling who caused the damage. Until Friday, there is no telling whether the event will proceed. There is no telling when the work will finish. There is no telling who caused the damage. There is no telling whether the event will proceed.

rules.zh: 可以放在較大的句子裏問題是，我們無法得知升降機何時修好。 導遊警告我們，當時無法預料天氣會以多快的速度轉變。 這些外層結構增加句式變化，但 There is / was no telling 仍然是核心表達。
rules.en: The problem is that there is no telling when the lift will be repaired. The guide warned us that there was no telling how quickly the weather might change.

rules.zh: 它通常比 I do not know 語氣更強我不知道火車何時到達。 這句只表示說話者本人不知道。火車何時到達，實在無法得知。 這句表示目前沒有可靠方法可以知道或預測答案。因此，不應把每一個 I do not know 都機械地改成 There is no telling。
rules.en: I do not know when the train will arrive. There is no telling when the train will arrive.

rules.zh: 常用於未來發展、不確定原因和未知結果這個句型特別適合談論：未來會發生甚麼；某件事何時發生；某個過程需要多久；誰會作出某項決定；某件事為甚麼發生；某個計劃能否成功；數量、費用或程度會是多少。
rules.en: The structure is especially useful for unknown future developments, causes and outcomes: what or when something will happen, how long it will take, who will decide, why it happened, whether a plan will succeed, or what a quantity, cost or degree will be.

benefits.zh: 自然地表達無法預測的情況這個句型可以清楚表示，目前沒有人能確定答案。局勢會如何發展，實在無法預料。 它特別適合談論天氣、市場、交通、調查和未來計劃。
benefits.en: There is no telling how the situation will develop.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 I do not know 較普通：【I do not know when the repairs will finish.】 較自然地表達整體不確定性：【There is no telling when the repairs will finish.】 使用這個句型可以令說話和寫作不會不斷重複 I do not know。
benefits.en: I do not know when the repairs will finish. There is no telling when the repairs will finish.

benefits.zh: 清楚指出哪一項資料無法確定目標表達【Wh-clause】可以精確指出未知的是時間、人物、地點、原因、數量還是結果。無法預料誰會領導這個項目。 無法預料這個項目需要多少費用。 讀者能立即知道哪一項資料仍然不確定。
benefits.en: Wh-clause There is no telling who will lead the project. There is no telling how much the project will cost.

benefits.zh: 幫助你避免作出過分肯定的預測當證據不足時，這個句型可以提醒讀者，某個結果仍然無法確定。新政策能否奏效，目前仍無法預料。 這比直接聲稱政策一定成功或失敗更準確。
benefits.en: There is no telling whether the new policy will work.

benefits.zh: 可以配合不同句子框架你可以把核心句型放在不同位置：【At this stage, there is no telling what will happen.】 這能增加句式變化，不需要讓每一句都以 There 開始。
benefits.en: At this stage, there is no telling what will happen. The problem is that there is no telling what will happen. Officials admitted that there was no telling what would happen.

benefits.zh: 適合日常對話和正式寫作這個句型可用於：日常對話；作文；新聞報道；報告；商業分析；簡報；對未來發展的評論。它既能表達自然的口語語氣，也能在較正式的內容中表示審慎和不確定性。
benefits.en: It works in both everyday conversation and formal writing, including essays, news reports, business analysis, presentations and commentary on future developments. It expresses uncertainty naturally while remaining appropriately cautious.
